title: Migrate deploy plugin to contract v2
goal: Migrate plugins/agent/deploy to result_contract v2: v2 result shape on every exit path, ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR for output, ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS for input resolution, rc ∈ {0,1}, explicit disposition values, and manifest result_contract:2 declaration.

steps.description: Write v2 test assertions first (RED step). Update the existing test helper _make_state to set ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR (pointing at the run's artifacts dir) and write a minimal ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS JSON file that maps input ids (pr_url, gate_aggregator_result) to their fixture paths; update all per-SPEC run setups to use these env vars instead of implicit path construction. Revise SPEC-7 to assert result_contract=2 (not schema_version=1). Revise SPEC-8 to assert rc=1 (not rc=2) for a missing gate. Add SPEC-9: manifest declares result_contract:2 under provides. Add SPEC-10: every terminal exit path produces a file with result_contract=2 (probe dry-run, missing-pr-url, missing-gate, gate-non-pass paths). Add SPEC-11: no hardcoded artifact path construction in plugin.sh (grep asserts no local.*_in= and no local.*_out= path vars). Add SPEC-12: no config.router block in manifest (deploy makes no LLM calls). Add SPEC-13: rc=1 on all error paths (missing pr-url→rc=1; missing gate→rc=1). Add SPEC-14: all error results carry disposition field. Add SPEC-15: missing-gate disposition=broken; deploy-release-missing disposition=broken; deploy-release-failure disposition=unavailable; gate-non-pass disposition=complete; dry-run disposition=complete; success disposition=complete. Add SPEC-16: manifest valid_verdicts covers all three verdicts (deployed, error, skipped) and no others. Add SPEC-17: deploy-release absent → verdict=error, disposition=broken, rc=1. Add SPEC-18: deploy-release returns non-zero → verdict=error, disposition=unavailable, rc=1. Add SPEC-19: hooks block contains only run: (no cleanup:). Add SPEC-20: dry-run v2 result shape has result_contract=2, verdict=deployed, disposition=complete, reason non-empty. Add SPEC-21: passing-gate success result has result_contract=2, verdict=deployed, disposition=complete. These must all fail (red) against the unmodified plugin.sh.

Add result_contract:2 under the provides block in the manifest. The manifest already satisfies all other v2 requirements: provides.role (deploy_agent), provides.events (4 events), primary:true output on deploy_result, valid_verdicts covering all three verdicts, no config.router block, and no cleanup hook. This step is a single-line addition.

Rewrite plugin.sh for v2 contract. (a) Add _deploy_write_result helper (mirrors validate's pattern): writes result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason, data via jq | atomic_write to artifact_dir/deploy-result.json. (b) Update deploy_agent_run: on missing state_file, write v2 result to ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR and return rc=1 (not rc=2). (c) Rewrite _deploy_agent_run_inner: derive artifacts_dir from ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR (fail with rc=1 if absent); resolve pr_url_in via ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS (.inputs.pr_url); resolve gate_result_in via ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS (.inputs.gate_aggregator_result); delete the three local path-construction variables (pr_url_in=$artifacts_dir/pr-url.txt, gate_result_in=$artifacts_dir/gate-aggregator-result.json, deploy_result_out=$artifacts_dir/deploy-result.json); replace all bare printf/jq result writes with _deploy_write_result calls; set dispositions per the table (broken for missing pr_url / missing gate / missing deploy-release plugin; complete for deliberate skip and success and dry-run; unavailable when deploy_release_run returns non-zero); clamp all error returns to rc=1 (eliminates all rc=2 returns and the bare return "$_rc" on deploy-release failure); add explicit _deploy_write_result call on the success path after deploy_release_run succeeds (the v1 code delegated the write to the tool; the agent now owns its own result). Preserve the fail-closed gate allowlist, ZBUILD_DRY_RUN guard, and delegation to deploy_release_run.

notes: 1. Primary output: deploy_result already declares primary:true in the existing manifest — the acceptance checkbox is already met; step-2 records it explicitly in notes only. 2. Router budgets: deploy makes no LLM calls. No config.router block is added. SPEC-12 tests that no config.router block exists in the manifest, matching the acceptance criterion. 3. Cleanup/release hook: deploy holds no live resources. The hooks block retains only run:; SPEC-19 enforces this. 4. Disposition for deploy-release failure: when deploy_release_run returns non-zero, the release side-effect (git-tag + gh release create) may have partially executed — the remote state is unknown. This maps to unavailable (not broken), consistent with deploy-release's own v2 result for push failure (#1849 SPEC-30). 5. Disposition for deploy-release missing: the plugin was never sourced and no side-effect ran — this is a structural/installation fault, so broken. 6. Dry-run result: v2 shape with verdict=deployed (not 'skipped') and disposition=complete, matching the intent that a dry-run is a deliberate non-deployment, not a failure. Data field carries pr_url and mode:dry_run. SPEC-2 and SPEC-20 both cover this path. 7. Success path write: v1 delegated the deploy-result.json write to deploy-release; v2 requires the agent to own its own result (the tool writes its own result to its own artifact dir). After migration, _deploy_agent_run_inner calls _deploy_write_result after a successful deploy_release_run return. 8. Test setup change: all per-SPEC run blocks must set ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR (pointing to $TEST_TEMP_DIR/runN/artifacts) and write a ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS JSON file with .inputs.pr_url and .inputs.gate_aggregator_result paths. The _make_state helper is updated to produce a stage-inputs.json file, and ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS is exported to point to it. The delegation mock (SPEC-2 lower block) also needs ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR. 9. SPEC-8 rc change: v1 returns rc=2 for a missing gate. v2 clamps to rc=1. The test currently asserts rc=2; it must be updated to rc=1 before the implementation step. 10. Template: config/templates/deployed.yaml already has deploy in the live flow with roles:[deploy_agent]. No template change is needed. 11. The acceptance item 'reddens at the merge-base' is satisfied by step-1 being committed before step-3: the test tree is committed first so the mutation tier can engage. The RED step note in the PR body must state the assertion and how it failed against the unmodified plugin.
